static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.family_status: Living with partner (partner is supportive but has limited understanding of the negative thoughts); has children (needs to coordinate the boys' sports activities with motherhood)
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with suppliers and customers affected by negativity and lack of enthusiasm; interactions with friend groups feel superficial and distant, unwilling to express true feelings
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, positive attitude; able to Reflect on one's own state and accept suggestions, but with evident negative Automatic thoughts and catastrophizing tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly feel I can never make my craft shop succeed, which makes me feel despair and helplessness.
basic_info.core_demands: Due to the shop's lack of progress and persistent negative thoughts, hopes to obtain professional help and guidance.
growth_experiences: After opening the shop, negative predictions about its prospects began under high stress; experiencing despair and hopelessness almost daily during Sluggish sales or business challenges, struggling to see positive or growth possibilities; despite trying various marketing and promotion strategies, still not yet reaching Anticipation, leading to Work performance affected, interpersonal (suppliers and customers) impact, Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted; partner offers emotional support but struggles to fully understand the distress; feeling distant and identity-lost among friend groups over the past year, self-care time markedly reduced.

core_beliefs: I cannot make my business succeed

special_situations.event: Sluggish sales or poor revenue on the day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If sales are sluggish short-term, it means the future will not be good either, and I will most likely fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing promotion and marketing investment driven by Anxiety, repeatedly refreshing data to seek a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shop will never succeed, and I will never get better

special_situations.event: Encountering concrete business challenges (such as customer complaints, supply delays, etc.)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot handle problems perfectly, it means I am not suited for business
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing interactions with suppliers and customers, enthusiasm dropping to avoid exposing 'incompetence'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure, not suited to be a boss

special_situations.event: Some positive feedback or a small increase in sales appears
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is not significant and sustained success, it does not count as real progress
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Actively ignores or explains away positive information, continues self-criticism to maintain vigilance against failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is nothing, just good luck

special_situations.event: Monitoring of marketing campaign results not yet reaching Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I work hard but do not see immediate results, it means further effort is useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sacrifices sleep and diet to work overtime thinking or adjusting plans, giving up self-care
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everything will only get worse, I cannot turn it around at all

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and understood, longs to run the business well and be affirmed by others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, fearing being seen as incompetent or not understood
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being evaluated by staying distant
Preempting with self-criticism to gain a sense of control

object_relations.object_representation: Critical others who may negate oneself (customers/suppliers/bystanders)
Peers who do not understand and with superficial relationships

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When sales are sluggish or others ask about business progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will think I am incompetent, I do not do well
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describe oneself in a self-blaming and negating tone, downplaying external factors; reduce expressing needs, avoid seeking help.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Feels distant when with friends but is asked how she has been lately
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I express genuine feelings, I will be misunderstood or make the relationship worse
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoid deep topics, keep superficial small talk; restrained tone, brief answers, Displacing to neutral topics.

manifestations: No longer feeling belonging when gathering with friends, interactions increasingly superficial
Unwilling to express true feelings, worrying others do not understand
outcomes: Weak, lost sense of identity and self

manifestations: Persistently pessimistic about the shop's prospects, hard to see positive and growth possibilities
Questioning one's own worth and whether one is a good friend/good Mother
outcomes: Strengthened sense of despair and hopelessness

manifestations: Between motherhood and running the business, hard to leave time for oneself
Self-care placed in a secondary position
outcomes: Difficulty making choices for one's own needs, further Repressing the self

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses to express or make requests toward others, turning the energy originally meant to be sent outward onto themselves.
manifestations: Not expressing feelings of distance and loss when with friends
Choosing to endure when support is needed, not seeking help

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming friends will not understand, and expressing will make the relationship worse
Assuming others will negate oneself in business interactions

contact_model.definition: The individual has excessive self-limitations and self-criticism, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently questioning self-worth; worrying about being evaluated
Being cautious in communication, avoiding exposing vulnerability

exception_events.target_problem: When stress and negative thinking run high, the client usually sinks into persistent low mood and helplessness, struggling with self-care.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At certain moments, the client chooses to take a short walk or read, the emotions are momentarily relieved, and the state is slightly improved compared to before.
exception_events.reason: Clue: adopted a different approach (proactively doing brief self-care, like walking/reading), briefly stepping away from the stressful situation, thus experiencing mild emotional relief.

positive_force: The partner provides some emotional support
Actively seeking professional help and guidance
Has tried marketing and promotion strategies many times to improve the business
Able to identify and try brief self-care (reading/walking), willing to start small
Positive attitude and high cooperation in sessions
negative_force: A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future that reinforces hopelessness
Negating positive evidence and excessively labeling the self
Role overload leading to insufficient self-care, energy depletion
Social distancing and not expressing needs make The support system has difficulty functioning
Sleep and eating disrupted, further weakening emotional and cognitive resources

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic predictions about the shop's prospects and repeated negative thinking (accompanied by a sense of despair)
antecedent: Sluggish sales or poor revenue on the day
Encounters business challenges (customer complaints, supply delays)
Checking marketing data or promotion results not reaching Anticipation
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by the core belief 'I am a failure/unable to succeed', interpreting current information in an extreme way.
target_behavior.function: By presupposing the worst outcome, avoids hope and renewed disappointment, gaining a brief sense of control and certainty
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance; relationships with suppliers and customers affected; Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance, overall quality of life reduced

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing true feelings and needs to friends (Social withdrawal)
antecedent: Feels distant when gathering or interacting with friends
Worrying that expression will be misunderstood or worsen relationships
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being negated and not understood, highly sensitive to interpersonal evaluation
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential conflict or embarrassment, maintaining surface security
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships growing more distant, increased sense of Loneliness, weakened sense of self-worth
